label: DORA Article 19 major ICT-related incident reporting
citation: Regulation (EU) 2022/2554, Article 19; RTS on reporting time limits

sources.title: Bank of Latvia incident reporting summary

statusNote: In force since 2025-01-17. Uncertain: secondary sources differ on the intermediate and final report anchors. Check the adopted RTS on reporting time limits.

triggers.label: Classified as major
triggers.hint: The entity classifies the incident as major under Article 18.

clocks.label: Initial notification
clocks.rule: Within 4 hours of classifying the incident as major, and no later than 24 hours after becoming aware of it.

clocks.label: Intermediate report
clocks.rule: Within 72 hours of the initial notification.

clocks.label: Final report
clocks.rule: Within one month of the latest intermediate report.
